Keep the entire layout, aspect ratio, photo positions and actual photographed content, section order, all words, punctuation, quantities and menu items identical. Do NOT replace, regenerate or stylize the four photographs. Do NOT add or remove sections, nav links, text, people, products, decorative logos or browser chrome. Output ONE complete sharp high-resolution website screenshot, ideally 1536x1152 or larger. The text must remain crisp and correctly spelled, never blurred, degraded, distorted or illegible.
Exact invariant copy: "CAFFÈ LUCE"; nav "Menu", "Il locale", "Contatti"; hero "Una pausa, ogni giorno."; "Caffè, dolci e incontri."; "Scopri il menu"; "Il nostro menu"; items "Caffè" / "Espresso e cappuccino", "Croissant" / "Ogni mattina", "Tè" / "Una selezione di aromi"; contact "Ti aspettiamo", "Lun–Sab · 7–19", "In centro, ogni giorno."; footer "CAFFÈ LUCE", "Un luogo per una pausa". ONLY STYLE CHANGE:
EARLY HTML / FIRST WEB, circa 1995. Default Times New Roman-like black serif text on plain white, blue underlined links, thin gray horizontal rules, square image edges, ordinary gray native HTML button labeled Scopri il menu. No gradients, textures, custom shadows, modern cards or pill controls. Preserve the source's 2-column hero and 3 menu columns as a simple HTML table layout; same pictures and readable section hierarchy.
